newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer plugs dry well, testing continues.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer plugs dry well, testing continues.

text.p: Pioneer Oil and Gas said on Tuesday its Maverick Springs well in White Pine County, Nevada was completed to a depth of 9,583 feet as a dry hole with oil shows, then plugged and abandoned.

But the company said the other untested structure on the prospect was substantially larger and appeared to be a likely source of the high soil gas readings of propane and butane found over the property.

"The high geochemical readings (soil gas) still indicate a substantial source of hydrocarbons in the area of our prospect," said Don Colton, company president. "The most likely candidate is the second untested structure which is surrounded by high soil gas readings."
He said this structure could have substantially more oil reserves than the company originally thought existed in the first structure.
Pioneer also said plans were underway to drill another Bedford prospect well, extending this field southwards.
